0022600171.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-3, 2-1 at home, 1-2 on the road, 3rd in the Atlantic and 5th in the East) visit the LA Clippers (1-5, 0-4 on the road, on a five-game losing streak, 13th in the West) in the Raptors' seventh game of the season. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. LA is missing Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery), Max Strus (out, foot plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery), with Derrick Jones Jr. day-to-day with a knee issue. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Raptors lost both games to the Clippers in 2025-26, most recently 119-94 in Los Angeles on March 25, 2026.
